questions.cardText:
[Archaeology] The significance of the Rosetta Stone lies in its role in:
A. Facilitating the decipherment of Egyptian hieroglyphs
B. Providing the earliest known example of hieroglyphic writing
C. Presenting the earliest evidence of writing in ancient civilizations
Answer: A. In the 18th century, Egyptian hieroglyphs were a complete mystery. The Rosetta Stone was crucial in understanding hieroglyphs because it has the same text in both Greek, which was known, and hieroglyphs, allowing scholars to finally decode the hieroglyphs.
questions.de: Welche antike Schrift half der Stein von Rosette, der dasselbe Dekret auf Griechisch und auf Ägyptisch trägt, zu entziffern?
questions.en: Which ancient script did the Rosetta Stone, carrying the same decree in Greek and in Egyptian, help scholars decipher?

timeline.labelEn: Jean-François Champollion announces the decipherment of the Egyptian scripts in Paris
timeline.labelDe: Jean-François Champollion verkündet in Paris die Entzifferung der ägyptischen Schriften

questions.notes: The stone carries three versions: hieroglyphic, Demotic and Ancient Greek; the card omits Demotic.

questions.cardText:
[Economics] “Fiscal policy” involves government decisions about:
A. Spending and taxation
B. Money supply
C. Trade and tariffs
Answer: A.
questions.de: Wie nennt man den Einsatz von Staatsausgaben und Steuern durch eine Regierung, um die Wirtschaft zu beeinflussen?
questions.en: What is the term for a government's use of spending and taxation to influence the economy?

timeline.labelEn: Fiscal policy as a macroeconomic tool develops in reaction to the Great Depression, on Keynes's theories
timeline.labelDe: Fiskalpolitik als makroökonomisches Instrument entsteht als Antwort auf die Weltwirtschaftskrise, gestützt auf Keynes
